string.text: Toggle uses vanilla Settings - Controls "Ammo Selector" (wpn_next). Hold uses the key below (MCM-only; may overlap other binds).
Toggle: vanilla release-to-open. Hold: open on press, close on release (no next-ammo cycle from the bind itself). Number keys still pick a load while the wheel is open.
Hold mode only. Wait this long after press before opening. Release earlier to cancel (no open). Close is still immediate. Use 0 for instant open.
Hold mode only. Releasing the key while the cursor is over an ammo slot selects it (same as clicking). If nothing is hovered, the wheel just closes.
Hold mode only. Set this to the same key as Settings - Controls - Ammo Selector if you want one bind. Overlaps with other keys are allowed here.
